text:
maria: Quick sync — marketplace launch in 48h. We need a partner-facing SEV path + shared Slack/war-room play for the SI + cloud partner. Who owns liaison and escalation matrix? cc @alex @sam @jenna

alex: I can own the SEV runbook. Proposal: one shared channel per partner + a dedicated war-room channel for any Sev2/Sev1. Use pinned runbook + short triage checklist. :thumbsup:

sam: Agree. Oncall should be pageable for partner incidents. Suggest rotation: partner-liaison@pager, then product oncall, then eng-sre. Also define who flips the bridge.

jenna: We need an ops checklist template for partners: contacts, escalation ladder, fallback model routing, capacity thresholds, allowed mitigation (rate-limits), and communication templates for partner PMs.

maria: I'll draft contact tree. Can we include SI technical lead and partner support alias? Need SLAs for responses (15m ack for Sev1).

alex: 15m ack sounds good. For War-room flow I propose commands snippet: ```/warroom create partner-<short> --level sev1 --owner @alex``` and add a slackbot to auto-invite partner handles and push pinned runbook.

ops-bot: automation: created war room #warroom-partners-2230012345 and invited @alex @sam @jenna

sam: :eyes: Add a fallback model routing policy — if primary infra overloaded, route to hosted-compat model with throttling. Avoid data plane exposure.

jenna: Also pre-authorize partner SIs to join private warroom for technical deep dives. Add a checklist item: 'enable partner SSO/invite'

maria: I'll circulate the one-pager and contact spreadsheet in #partnerships after this thread. Quick ask: can each of you add 2 emergency contacts for your teams by EOD?

alex: Adding mine now. + I'll write the runbook template and push to docs repo with link.

sam: Adding rotation leads. Also test run tomorrow: 10m drill to validate invites and bridge creation.

maria: Perfect. Thanks folks. :rocket:
